title: DPC 0.9.178-dev9 re-checks: Ctrl+F6 from keyboard, player 2's camera with both on pawns, Galvanize
intro: About 8 min. Two controllers; a Sorcerer and a Mage pawn with Galvanize (hire or switch one in first). End skips a step.

probes.ver: local A=_G.DPC_API; return A and A.dpc_version or 'no API'
probes.coop: local R=_G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R; local s=_G.DPC_API.state(); if not s.coop.active then return 'off' end; local t={}; for i,c in pairs(s.coop.players) do t[#t+1]='P'..i..'='..tostring(c and c.name) end; return table.concat(t,' ')..' ('..tostring(R.cp and R.cp.mode)..')'
probes.p2cam: local R=_G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R; return 'both-on-pawns camera adds '..tostring(R.cp_cam_n or 0)
probes.galv: local R=_G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R; return R and R.galv_last and tostring(R.galv_last):sub(1,160) or '-'

steps.text: Start: ver 0.9.178-dev9, co-op off. Press End.

1/3 CTRL+F6 FROM KEYBOARD: use a controller briefly, then play on mouse and keyboard for a few seconds, press Ctrl+F6, then a button on controller A (player 2). Then L3+R3 on controller B: player 3 joins. Player 1 stays on keyboard/mouse only. End co-op. End.
2/3 BOTH ON PAWNS: take a pawn (player 1), start co-op, player 2 switches to another pawn. Player 2 turns the camera ~15 s; the counter at the top climbs. Every time? End co-op. End.
3/3 GALVANIZE: out of combat take over the Sorcerer, use some stamina, hold Galvanize ~2 s. 'galv' updates (job 6), stamina rises during the hold. Then the same on the Mage (job 3). End.
Done. Tell Claude pass/fail per step. End.
